name: FormFlow for GoHighLevel (GHL) – Send Form Leads to GHL CRM
author: NexPlugs

sections.description:
🌐 Official Website | 📖 Documentation | 🧑‍💻 Support

FormFlow for GoHighLevel (GHL) allows Gravity Forms, Contact Form 7, Elementor Forms, Fluent Forms, Ninja Forms, and WPForms submissions to be automatically synced with GoHighLevel CRM.

Whether you need to send Contact Form 7 leads to GoHighLevel, connect Gravity Forms with GHL, sync WPForms submissions, integrate Elementor Forms with GoHighLevel CRM, connect Fluent Forms to GHL, or route Ninja Forms leads into GoHighLevel locations, FormFlow provides a simple and reliable solution.

The plugin supports multiple popular WordPress form builders and allows users to route submissions to specific GoHighLevel locations with form-level controls and tagging support.

Use Cases

Popular use cases include:

☑️ Send Contact Form 7 leads to GoHighLevel CRM
☑️ Connect Elementor Forms with GoHighLevel (GHL)
☑️ Sync Gravity Forms submissions to GoHighLevel locations
☑️ Send WPForms entries to GoHighLevel automatically
☑️ Connect Fluent Forms with GoHighLevel CRM
☑️ Route Ninja Forms leads to specific GHL locations
☑️ Automatically create GoHighLevel contacts from WordPress forms
☑️ Apply GoHighLevel tags based on submitted forms
☑️ Route leads to different GoHighLevel sub-accounts
☑️ Automate lead capture workflows between WordPress and GHL
☑️ Connect WordPress forms with GoHighLevel marketing automation
☑️ Send website leads directly into GoHighLevel CRM pipelines

Supported integrations:

☑️ Contact Form 7
☑️ Elementor Forms
☑️ Gravity Forms
☑️ Fluent Forms
☑️ Ninja Forms
☑️ WPForms

Features

☑️ Secure GoHighLevel (GHL) account authentication
☑️ Multi-location GoHighLevel support
☑️ Form-specific lead routing
☑️ Global tag support
☑️ Form-specific tag support
☑️ Automatic lead synchronization
☑️ Automatic contact creation in GoHighLevel (GHL) CRM
☑️ Contact Form 7 to GoHighLevel (GHL) integration
☑️ Elementor Forms to GoHighLevel (GHL) integration
☑️ Gravity Forms to GoHighLevel (GHL) integration
☑️ Fluent Forms to GoHighLevel (GHL) integration
☑️ Ninja Forms to GoHighLevel (GHL) integration
☑️ WPForms to GoHighLevel (GHL) integration
☑️ Built-in activity logging and troubleshooting
☑️ Lightweight and optimized architecture
☑️ Agency-friendly workflow

FormFlow GHL Pro

Need more than name, email and phone? FormFlow GHL Pro adds a Feeds engine:

☑️ Custom field mapping – map any form field to standard GHL fields (company, address, website) or your own GHL custom fields
☑️ Pipelines and opportunities – create an opportunity in the pipeline and stage you choose
☑️ Conditional routing – send leads based on their answers (equals, not equals, contains, starts with, greater than)
☑️ Multiple feeds per form – send one submission to several GHL locations
☑️ Feed-specific tags – tag leads by the rule that fired
☑️ Multiple primary accounts – connect completely separate GoHighLevel accounts

Every plan includes all Pro features. Pick by site count: 2, 4 or unlimited. See plans and pricing

Supported Form Plugins

Contact Form 7

Automatically sync Contact Form 7 submissions into GoHighLevel.

Elementor Forms

Capture Elementor form submissions and send them directly into GoHighLevel.

Gravity Forms

Connect Gravity Forms to GoHighLevel without Zapier. Every Gravity Forms entry creates or updates a GHL contact, sent to the location and tags you choose for that form.

Fluent Forms

Automatically push Fluent Forms submissions into GoHighLevel.

Ninja Forms

Connect Ninja Forms with GoHighLevel for seamless lead automation.

WPForms

Sync WPForms entries directly into your GoHighLevel account.

Multi-Location Support

FormFlow for GoHighLevel (GHL) securely authenticates with a single primary GoHighLevel account while allowing agencies and businesses to manage leads across multiple location (sub-accounts).

Assign specific forms to different GoHighLevel locations directly from the plugin settings.

Tags Support

Automatically apply tags to contacts inside GoHighLevel.

Supported tagging options:

☑️ Global tags
☑️ Form-specific tags

This helps organize leads, trigger workflows, and automate marketing inside GoHighLevel.

External Services

This plugin relies on external third-party/external services to provide authentication and CRM lead synchronization functionality.

1. NexPlugs API (api.nexplugs.com)

This plugin communicates with the NexPlugs API service hosted at:

https://api.nexplugs.com

Purpose of this service:

The NexPlugs API is required for:

  • Secure GoHighLevel account authentication
  • GoHighLevel location connection management
  • Processing WordPress form submission data
  • Creating or updating CRM contacts in connected GoHighLevel accounts

What data is sent and when:

On GoHighLevel account connection:
– Website URL / domain

On GoHighLevel account disconnect:
* Website URL / domain
* Connected GoHighLevel location/account identifiers

On supported WordPress form submission:
* Contact name
* Contact email
* Contact phone number
* Form source identifier
* Configured tags
* Selected GoHighLevel location/account identifiers
* Form submission values required for CRM contact creation/update

This data is transmitted only when these actions are performed by the website administrator or when a site visitor submits a supported form.

Privacy Policy:
https://nexplugs.com/privacy-policy/

Terms of Service:
https://nexplugs.com/terms-of-service/

2. GoHighLevel API (rest.gohighlevel.com)

Once connected, the plugin sends WordPress form submission data to the GoHighLevel CRM API via the NexPlugs proxy to create or update contacts.

What data is sent and when:

  • On every WordPress form submission (from Contact Form 7, Elementor Forms, Gravity Forms, Fluent Forms, Ninja Forms, or WPForms): The contact’s name, email address, phone number, the form source identifier, and any configured tags are sent to the GoHighLevel API to create or update a contact record in the selected GoHighLevel sub-account location.

This data is only sent when a user submits a form on your WordPress website. No data is sent in the background or without a form submission event.

This service is provided by HighLevel Inc. (GoHighLevel):
* Privacy Policy: https://www.gohighlevel.com/privacy-policy
* Terms of Service: https://www.gohighlevel.com/terms
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin folder to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory, or install the plugin through the WordPress plugins screen.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ screen in WordPress.
  3. Go to FormFlow for GoHighLevel in the WordPress admin menu.
  4. Connect your GoHighLevel account.
  5. Select your GoHighLevel locations.
  6. Configure form settings and tags.
  7. Start syncing leads directly into GoHighLevel.
sections.faq:
Which WordPress forms are supported?

Currently supported:

☑️ Contact Form 7
☑️ Elementor Forms
☑️ Gravity Forms
☑️ Fluent Forms
☑️ Ninja Forms
☑️ WPForms

Can I connect multiple GoHighLevel (GHL) locations?

Yes. FormFlow for GoHighLevel (GHL) supports multiple GoHighLevel locations and sub-accounts.

Can I connect multiple GoHighLevel (GHL) accounts?

Currently, the free version supports only one primary GoHighLevel account. You can connect multiple sub-accounts (locations) under that single account.

Can I assign different forms to different GHL locations?

Yes. Form-specific location routing is supported.

Can I add tags automatically?

Yes. The plugin supports both global tags and form-specific tags.

Can I view API errors or sync issues?

Yes, FormFlow for GoHighLevel includes a built-in logging system within the WordPress admin dashboard to track connection status and API communication events safely and securely.

Does the plugin support custom fields?

Yes, in FormFlow GHL Pro. The free version syncs name, email and phone. Pro maps any form field to standard or custom GHL fields.

Can FormFlow create opportunities in a GHL pipeline?

Yes, with FormFlow for GHL Pro. Each feed can create an opportunity in the pipeline and stage you choose.

How is FormFlow For GHL different from the LeadConnector plugin?

LeadConnector places GoHighLevel forms, funnels and widgets on WordPress. FormFlow for GHL works the other way: you keep your existing WordPress forms and FormFlow for GHL sends their submissions into GoHighLevel.

How do I connect Gravity Forms to GoHighLevel?

Install FormFlow for GoHighLevel(GHL), connect your GoHighLevel account, then choose a GHL location and tags for your Gravity Form. New entries are sent to GoHighLevel automatically.

Is WooCommerce supported?

WooCommerce integration is planned for future releases.

How can I get support?

For plugin-related help and support, please contact:

support@nexplugs.com

Does the plugin remove data on uninstall?

Yes. FormFlow for GoHighLevel includes a clean uninstall process and follows WordPress coding standards.
